title: ComplianceAtlas: A Taxonomy-Driven Agentic AI Framework for Automated AI Act Gap Analysis and Remediation
title_zh: ComplianceAtlas：一个面向《AI 法案》差距分析与整改的基于分类学的智能体 AI 框架

paragraphs.en: 提出基于合规差距分类学的智能体框架ComplianceAtlas,显著提升AI法案差距分析与整改规划效果。 Assessing regulatory compliance for high-risk AI systems requires systematic identification of technical gaps such as missing controls, in- adequate processes, or shallow evaluation of practices. Compliance officers typically admin- ister structured questionnaires collecting evi- dence of current practices, where organizations respond with descriptions of their existing pro- cesses, technical capabilities, and architectural choices. However, translating these compli- ance questionnaire responses into typed, ac- tionable gap diagnoses remains unsystematic. In this paper, we present a literature-grounded taxonomy of technical compliance gaps cover- ing areas such as accuracy, robustness, logging, and human oversight, and embed it in GapTo- Compliance, a two-stage agentic framework coordinating two specialized agents: a Gap Extraction Agent that performs hierarchical rea- soning from compliance areas to specific gap types, and a Remediation Planning Agent that ranks remediation actions from a remediation catalog via multi-signal scoring combining se- mantic similarity, regulatory alignment, and effort estimation. We evaluate this framework against four automatic compliance gap detec- tion baselines across 9 AI systems and 6 AI families. Our approach achieves a gap-type F1 of 0.831 (vs. 0.533 for the strongest baseline) and remediation P@5 of 0.872 (vs. 0.635 for retrieval methods), demonstrating promising potential for automated compliance workflows. The structured agent coordination reveals a path toward human-in-the-loop compliance systems where automated gap extraction reduces expert burden while maintaining auditability, and the taxonomy-driven design enables extension to emerging regulatory frameworks beyond
paragraphs.zh: 提出基于合规差距分类学的智能体框架ComplianceAtlas，显著提升AI法案差距分析与整改规划效果。评估高风险AI系统的监管合规性需要系统地识别诸如缺失控制措施、流程不完善或实践评估浅显等技术差距。 合规专员通常通过管理结构化问卷来收集当前实践的证据，各组织则以对现有流程、技术能力和架构选择的描述进行回应。 然而，将这些合规问卷回答转化为类型化、可操作的差距诊断仍然缺乏系统性。 在本文中，我们提出了一个以文献为基础的技术合规差距分类学，涵盖准确性、鲁棒性、日志记录和人类监督等领域，并将其嵌入GapToCompliance——一个两阶段智能体框架，协调两个专用智能体：一个是差距提取智能体，执行从合规领域到具体差距类型的分层推理；另一个是整改规划智能体，通过结合语义相似性、监管对齐和工作量估算的多信号评分，从整改目录中对整改行动进行排序。 我们在9个AI系统和6个AI家族上，将此框架与四个自动合规差距检测基线进行了对比评估。 我们的方法实现了0.831的差距类型F1值（最强基线为0.533）和0.872的整改P@5（检索方法为0.635），展现了自动化合规工作流的良好潜力。 这种结构化的智能体协作揭示了通向人在回路合规系统的路径，其中自动化的差距提取在保持可审计性的同时减轻专家负担，而分类学驱动的设计使其能够扩展到新兴监管框架之外。
